Package bg.tu_varna.ks

package bg.tu_varna.ks
Root package of the calendar information system.

Contains the application's entry point - Application, which starts the REPL loop and forwards every line of user input to the command subsystem.

Architecture

The project is split into the following logical layers:

  • bg.tu_varna.ks.contracts - interfaces defining the common abstractions in the system.
  • bg.tu_varna.ks.models - domain models (Calendar, Event).
  • bg.tu_varna.ks.command - command definition and dispatching.
  • bg.tu_varna.ks.command.utility - system commands (open, save, etc.).
  • bg.tu_varna.ks.command.events - commands operating on events.
  • bg.tu_varna.ks.command.factories - command factory.
  • bg.tu_varna.ks.command.files - data persistence (JAXB).
  • bg.tu_varna.ks.command.files.adapters - JAXB adapters for date/time.

Patterns used

  • Singleton - Calendar, CommandFactory, AppData.
  • Builder - Event.EventBuilder.
  • Factory - CommandFactory.
  • Command / Strategy - Executable and all of its implementations.
